commands.name: Watch This Product
commands.prompt: The current tab is an Amazon product page. Find its ASIN: the 10 letters and digits after /dp/ or /gp/product/ in the address. Open yab://amazon-price-watch.boost/app/index.html?add=<ASIN> so Amazon Price Watch adds it, then say which product is now watched. If the tab is not an Amazon product page, say so and stop.
